title: The layman and the back beat in freedom music
summary: Sam says the working listener lost the beat with freedom music, and Ridley argues fusion revives it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

And, um, so when it came back it just came back with a little more force than it was before. It's the same music man. Rhythm and blues? It's the blues man, you know. But it's more electrifying, you know, it's more loud, it's more powerful now.
